description: Presentations, interviews, and community spotlights with local DEF CON Groups coordinators around the world during DEF CON 26.

talks.title: Spotlight on DC010 Beijing with Jun Li
talks.teaser: DEF CON Groups ambassador Jayson Street interviews Jun Li, founder of DC010 Beijing, discussing community growth and technical events in China.
talks.summary:
### Building Hacker Communities in China
At 00:00, Jason E. Street, Global Coordinator for DEF CON Groups, sits down with Jun Li, founder of DC010 Beijing, during a joint community gathering with DC86755 in Shenzhen. Street and Li discuss the mission of fostering grassroots hacker culture in China.

### Origins and Academic Partnerships of DC010
At 02:01, Jun Li recounts the founding of DC010 Beijing. He describes navigating formal institutional approvals to establish a welcoming physical space where university students, software engineers, and cybersecurity hobbyists could meet, collaborate, and share technical knowledge.

### Community Growth and Hands-On Technical Workshops
At 03:52, Li reflects on the group's first year of operations. He details how DC010 organized monthly technical meetups, CTF competitions, and interactive tutorials covering reverse engineering and hardware security, noting that attendance rapidly expanded beyond initial expectations.

### Countering Social Stigmas Surrounding Hackers
Concluding between 05:47 and 09:33, Li and Street discuss broader cultural perceptions. Li explains how DC010 actively works to dispel negative media stereotypes surrounding hackers, demonstrating to the broader public that hacker communities foster essential education, responsible research, and constructive technical curiosity.
